findings.evidence: `Contractable.identDistrib_coord` is already target-polymorphic at `Contractability.lean:91`, and Mathlib's `IdentDistrib.integral_eq` is polymorphic at `Probability/IdentDistrib.lean:185`; the roadmap asks for “equality of means and integrals” at `README.md:421`, not only real integrals.
findings.fix: Move it out of the real section and state it for any target `E` with `[MeasurableSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [BorelSpace E]`, using the same proof from `hX.identDistrib_coord`.
findings.issue: `Contractable.integral_coord_eq` is unnecessarily restricted to real-valued processes by the surrounding `section Real`.

findings.evidence: The current proof uses the stronger `covariance_eq_sub` at `Covariance.lean:67`, whose signature needs probability and `MemLp` (`Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Covariance.lean:54`), but `covariance` itself is just an integral for any measure (`Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Covariance.lean:44`) and `IdentDistrib.integral_eq` has no `MemLp` or probability hypothesis (`Mathlib/Probability/IdentDistrib.lean:185`).
findings.fix: Prove `covariance_eq_of_identDistrib_pair` directly from `covariance` and `IdentDistrib.integral_eq` applied to `(x.1 - μ[X]) * (x.2 - μ[Y])`, after deriving equality of the two means; then let the contractable covariance lemmas take `hX_meas : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (X n) μ` instead of `hX_L2` and drop the probability-measure assumptions.
findings.issue: `covariance_eq_of_identDistrib_pair` and the derived `Contractable.covariance_eq_of_lt`/`of_ne` require `[IsProbabilityMeasure]` and `MemLp 2`, but equality of covariance from an identical pair law only needs the pair law and a.e. measurability.

summary: The new API proves the intended facts, but two public statements are specialized below their natural Mathlib level. Generalize the reusable integral and covariance lemmas so downstream Layer 3 code is not forced into unnecessary real/probability/L² hypotheses.
